using InnoEngine.Reflection;
using InnoEngine.Scene;
using InnoEngine.Serialization;

[StableTypeId("e669c627-771a-4d3c-a09d-307dcd6b457e")]
[AllowMultipleComponent]
public sealed class WorkflowState : GameBehavior
{
    [SerializableProperty] public float number;
    [SerializableProperty] public GameObject? reference;
    [SerializableProperty] public int ticks;

    /// <inheritdoc />
    protected override void Update() => ticks++;
}
